shared_elements: upright freestanding stone monolith/pillar as the carved support
low-relief carving applied to the broad face of the standing slab
rectangular/tapering block form treated as a body or figure
curved, arc-like relief motifs (crescents/rings) on the shaft
justification: Both are upright slab-like monoliths bearing shallow relief on the broad face, and both include curved arc/ring motifs, but that is about as generic as monumental relief gets. A depicts recognisable quadrupeds in profile scattered on a blank pillar face, while B depicts an anthropomorphic figure with a head, shoulders and torso covered by symmetrical, arranged emblems (loops, discs, a belt-like band) — different subject matter, different organisation and different conventions.
